title: Convergence of the PML-BIE Method for Acoustic Scattering in an Impedance Half-Space
summary: The perfectly matched layer-based boundary integral equation (PML-BIE) method (Lu et al., \emph{SIAM J. Appl. Math.} 78 (2018)) has become an effective tool for wave scattering problems in unbounded domains. Despite its successful applications, a rigorous convergence theory has remained incomplete in many physically relevant settings. In this paper, we present a general framework for establishing convergence of PML-BIE methods, using acoustic scattering in an impedance half-space as the first illustrative example.
